svg.title: Use cases — dealership and platform staff

g.text: Use cases — dealership and platform staff
UC30 View the workshop day board
UC35 Move a job to another
UC36 See every job by status
UC41 Start, finish and close a job
UC42 Order parts for a job
Book for a phone / walk-in customer
Blue: in this version (customer, technician, system manager)
Solid grey: not in this version of the web app (the backend still has it)
Dashed grey: future work, not built
The dealership admin can do everything a service advisor can.
Moving a job and issuing parts are checked by database constraints
